prompt_template:
We have BAM files generated from Hiplex Cut&Tag experiments, located at:

/path/to/hiplex_data/bam

The goal is to identify peak regions for each CRF pair using hg38 as the reference genome, and conduct differential peak analysis between the C and T groups. First, compute genome-wide coverage and generate bedGraph files for each sample. Next, call peaks from each bedGraph: identify candidate signal blocks by AUC, assess each block's significance against its local background region (a window spanning 10 times the block length, centered on the block), and retain peaks with fold change ≥ 2 and q-value < 0.05 after multiple testing correction. For each CRF pair, perform pathway enrichment analysis on the identified peaks using Hallmark gene sets. Finally, conduct differential peak analysis between the C group (C1, C2) and the T group (T1, T2): build a consensus peak set, count reads within these regions, and identify differentially accessible regions (|log2FC| > 0.5, FDR < 0.05).

The dataset contains four samples: C1, C2, T1, and T2.

Use all available BAM files as-is without any additional filtering.

All intermediate files and final results should be written to the following output directory:
